versions.changelog:
antv-g6-graph 1.0.0

- Initial release of G6 v5 graph visualization code generation skill.
- Supports multiple graph types: network, tree, flow, etc., with unified initialization, layout, interaction, and plugin configuration.
- Enforces v5 API usage and data structure conventions (no v4 APIs, proper data nesting, style specifications).
- Provides detailed guides on layout options, behaviors, plugins, node/edge types, and common mistake patterns to avoid.
- Includes comprehensive code templates and best practice examples for quick integration.
